description:
The cost of Opus 5.5, Sonnet 5.5 and GPT-6.1 Sol is letting us use more agents than before. But does more parallel work mean more finished work—or more coordination?

We pick up where the last show left off: how we split tasks, where orchestration gets expensive, and what evidence we need before calling an agent done. We will also show the local workflow for preparing this livestream from our repo and public skills.

Bring your own agent workflow to chat: what do you delegate, and how do you check the result?

title: Cheaper AI. More Agents. What Actually Ships?
